Terror on the High Seas | How Pirates Ruled the Caribbean | Flashback with Palki Sharma
Who is your favourite character from Pirates of the Caribbean? Is it Jack Sparrow, Blackbeard or Henry Turner? Well, one of them is based on a real-life pirate. European ships were terrorised by Caribbean pirates in the 17th and 18th century. Catch the full story on Flashback with Palki Sharma.
